cover: What your prototype needs before it holds health data

slides.title: Keep the screens
slides.body: A prototype your staff already use has the workflow right. The work is in who can sign in and which records they can reach.

slides.title: Enforce access below every screen
slides.body: Put the access rule where every query passes through it. A misconfigured account should see nothing at all.

slides.title: Make secrets a deliberate reveal
slides.body: Encrypt logins and keys, hide them by default, and log every time someone shows one.

slides.title: Answer “who looked at this?”
slides.body: An append-only audit log keeps a timeline on every record and every user.

slides.title: Turn vague rules into decisions
slides.body: HIPAA requires automatic logoff but names no duration. Pick the numbers, and write down why.

slides.title: Test with realistic data first
slides.body: One pre-launch review found external accounts in lists meant for internal staff. Fixed before anyone signed in.
